text:
devon: Heads-up — I'm sketching an "edge bridge" playbook for how we standardize internal API shape across front-door/gateway vs service-to-service. Main questions: proto-first gRPC inside + JSON ingress? or keep everything JSON/REST and use a typed adapter? Thoughts?

anna: +1 for a playbook. My gut: proto-first reduces ambiguity but codegen pain for product teams that iterate fast. Need a good developer DX story. :thinking_face:

mike: We also need to consider the browser case. If internal is gRPC we need grpc-web at the edge or a JSON proxy. That adds an extra component and failure surface.

julie: Performance-wise unary gRPC inside the cluster wins for latency and smaller payloads. For public-facing endpoints JSON at the edge makes sense. The translation must be low-latency.

devon: Proposed compromise: accept JSON at north-south edge, translate to proto/gRPC at the gateway for internal services. Gateway owns header propagation, quotas, and telemetry. Sketch: 
```yaml
route:
  match: /api/v1/*
  ingress: accept: application/json
  transform: to_proto: true
  target: cluster-internal-grpc
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary playbook edge-bridge-v0.1 deployed to staging (pods: 3) :rocket:

mike: Quotas/limits: enforcement should be at the gateway to centralize counters. But console needs token-level breakdowns, so gateway must emit detailed telemetry (per-token, per-route) to our metrics pipeline. That means standardizing what fields we emit.

anna: Suggested header set to carry: x-rdwd-org, x-rdwd-request-id, x-rdwd-auth-scope. If we do proto transforms we should map header -> metadata consistently.

julie: Rollout UX note: we should support gradual rollout per-service with canary percentage and automatic rollback on increased 5xx or latency regressions. Also a "protocol-fallback" mode that routes to the legacy JSON proxy if proto decode fails.

devon: Agreed. Plan for canary config (pseudo):
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  health_signals:
    - latency_p50 < 120ms
    - error_rate < 0.5%
  fallback: legacy_json_proxy
  monitor_window: 10m
```

ops: SRE checklist: TLS termination points, cert rotation impacts, open ports for grpc-web, and observability before rollout. Also we need runbook for partial decode failures (how to surface to teams).

mike: Telemetry format proposal: emit proto.name, method, route, backend_variant, auth_scope, token_id_hash. Put token-level cost in our tracing span tags not metrics to avoid cardinality explosion; aggregate counts in metrics pipeline from spans.

anna: On developer DX: add a lightweight codegen CLI that emits typed stubs but supports incremental builds, plus a feature-flagged "no-codegen" JSON adapter for rapid iteration. That way product teams can iterate without full proto churn.

julie: Also add a lint/compat checker in CI that validates proto changes against a migration policy (no breaking changes without opt-in).

devon: Next steps: I'll put a first-draft RFC in the repo with the playbook, example configs, and a canary plan. Can folks review by EOD Thursday? If ok we'll wire the telemetry fields with eng-infra.

mike: Review acked, will add telemetry mapping.

anna: I'll draft the devex CLI proposal.

ops: I'll prep SRE runbook skeleton and cert checklist.

infra-bot: note: staging canary metrics: latency p50=95ms, errors=0.12% (last 15m)

devon: Nice — thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @mike for telemetry, @anna for devex, @ops for runbook. :thumbsup:
